0022600166.text: The Timberwolves (4-3, 9th in the West, coming off a loss) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, 14th in the East, on a two-game losing streak) with Minnesota fourth in the Northwest, one game back. Anthony Edwards is out following knee surgery after averaging 33.3 points and 33.7 minutes per game this season, and Donte DiVincenzo is out following Achilles surgery. Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 139-106 win in Milwaukee in their last meeting, and the teams have not played each other yet this season.
